description: Publish these additive columns before deploying Drafts and pricing 2026.5 together. This package-level route does not require the separate spare-parts catalog or its configuration.

re_packagepricedkone.description: Explicit opt-in. Absent/false preserves historical package pricing.

re_materialbeforemarkup.description: Server snapshot of Repair Package re_materialbeforemarkup; never use its _base companion. re_materialcostperunit retains the final re_materialmisctaxcost amount.

re_materialpricingmode.description: Leave null on existing records: their legacy/catalog semantics must not change. Package references have zero unit cost, descriptive quantities and manual part numbers.

deployment: Validate and publish the three columns; do not bulk-default the material choice on existing rows.
Confirm source Repair Package monetary columns and CSTM flags, currency, country and effective dates.
Deploy both backend assemblies in a controlled maintenance window before publishing the frontend. The old pricing assembly must not calculate package-priced snapshots.
Test as an estimator: save/reopen, equipment scaling, duplicate KONE references, mixed non-KONE materials, clone, historical drafts, and missing source amounts.
